ArtifactRef.description:
``GET /artifacts/{id}``: a controlled public download.

Carries a signed, short-lived download path issued by the API, never a storage URL. A private
artifact resolves to not-found, and a probe cannot obtain a usable token for one.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

ComparisonFilters.description: Task filters applied only to common task references and per-task differences.
ComparisonFilters.title: ComparisonFilters

ComparisonResult.description:
``GET /compare``: either a common-cohort comparison or typed incompatibility.

Exactly one of ``entries`` and ``incompatibilities`` is populated. A request that cannot be
compared returns the reasons and no numbers at all, so a partial entry can never be presented
as a full rank. Entry metrics and ``deltas`` retain their full-release aggregate scope;
``common_task_refs`` and ``paired_task_deltas`` use the disclosed task intersection after
``applied_filters``.
ComparisonResult.title: ComparisonResult

ComparisonScorecardRef.description: A scorecard that proves one selected configuration covered a public task version.
ComparisonScorecardRef.title: ComparisonScorecardRef

ComparisonTaskRef.description: One exact, disclosed task version shared by every selected configuration.
ComparisonTaskRef.title: ComparisonTaskRef

ContributionRow.description: One row of the exact contribution chain (Prompt 15's explanation contract).
ContributionRow.title: ContributionRow

Coverage.description:
How much of a cohort an entry actually covers.

``tasks`` is the number of tasks in the common cohort, not the number an entry found easy.
Coverage.title: Coverage

DimensionBreakdown.description: A language or model dimension's score and the coverage behind it.
DimensionBreakdown.title: DimensionBreakdown

Incompatibility.description:
Why two or more entries cannot be compared on a common cohort.

Typed rather than free text: the frontend must distinguish "these two models were never run on
the same task set" from "this entry is missing a language", and must never silently renormalise
a partial entry into a full rank (E2E-28).
Incompatibility.title: Incompatibility

LanguageEntryProfile.description: One model's language-specific metrics, diagnostics, and published coverage.
LanguageEntryProfile.title: LanguageEntryProfile

LanguageProfile.description:
``GET /languages/{id}``: dimension and diagnostic profile with opportunity counts.

``opportunity_count`` is the *measured* opportunity count. A feature the language cannot
observe is ``not_applicable`` rather than absent, so a chart cannot imply evidence for an
untested feature (Prompt 30, PCB-30-3).
LanguageProfile.title: LanguageProfile

LeaderboardEntry.description:
One row of ``GET /leaderboard``.

``rank`` is ``None`` whenever the release is exploratory: an exploratory release may publish an
unranked partial entry with explicit coverage but no recalculated all-language score
(T 19.4).
LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry

Methodology.description:
``GET /methodology/{version}``: the frozen methods behind a release.

Records what is native versus adapted, so a reader can tell an original benchmark's own metric
from this product's adaptation of it.
Methodology.title: Methodology

MetricRegistry.description:
The metric definitions a response ships alongside its values.

T 19.1: the API returns these definitions with a version so the frontend cannot implement its
own scoring formula.
MetricRegistry.title: MetricRegistry

ModelCapabilities.description:
What an endpoint/model can do. Adapters declare wire ceilings; operators declare
model facts. Effective capability is the conjunction; nothing is inferred from names.

output_cap_bounds_all_billed_output.title: Output Cap Bounds All Billed Output

ModelCapabilities.title: ModelCapabilities

ModelProfile.description:
``GET /models/{id}``: a published configuration-specific profile.

Carries no credentials, no provider secret reference and no endpoint URL (T 20.4).
ModelProfile.title: ModelProfile

ModelSubmission.description: Submitter-safe status. Review notes and internal plan identities are not returned here.
ModelSubmission.title: ModelSubmission

ModelSubmissionInput.description: Publicly acceptable information. Unknown fields (including credentials) are refused.
ModelSubmissionInput.title: ModelSubmissionInput

PairedDelta.description: Difference between published release aggregate metrics, not task-filtered metrics.
PairedDelta.title: PairedDelta

PairedTaskDelta.description: A per-task candidate-minus-baseline difference traced to both source scorecards.
PairedTaskDelta.title: PairedTaskDelta

PermissionReviewRecord.description: An internal, attributable decision about the submitter's source/permission declaration.
PermissionReviewRecord.title: PermissionReviewRecord

PublicMetric.description:
One public metric value with its availability made explicit.

``value``/``interval_low``/``interval_high`` are decimal strings or ``None``. A metric with no
measurement keeps the key present and null rather than being omitted, so the frontend cannot
mistake "not measured" for "not applicable".
PublicMetric.title: PublicMetric

PublicScorecard.description:
``GET /scorecards/{id}``: the public score breakdown.

``formula_version`` and ``policy_digest`` make the score reproducible; ``gating_status``
distinguishes a score of zero from a score that could not be produced at all.
PublicScorecard.title: PublicScorecard

PublicSourceVersion.description: Curated source text that is safe to disclose inside one published task release.
PublicSourceVersion.title: PublicSourceVersion

PublicSubmittedPatch.description: An explicitly released candidate diff; inert text tied to a public scorecard.
PublicSubmittedPatch.title: PublicSubmittedPatch

PublicTaskContent.description: On-demand content for one disclosed task version, never an upload or hidden oracle.
PublicTaskContent.title: PublicTaskContent

PublicToolFinding.description: A curated, location-bounded tool observation from a public task evaluation.
PublicToolFinding.title: PublicToolFinding

ReleaseSummary.description:
``GET /releases``: a published release's public identity and its disclosed limits.

Carries no manifest, no evidence bundle and no task identity list.
ReleaseSummary.title: ReleaseSummary

ResponseMeta.description: The exact transport metadata object serialized in an API envelope.
ResponseMeta.title: ResponseMeta

SubmissionReviewView.description: Private reviewer projection, available only after an explicit review permission check.
SubmissionReviewView.title: SubmissionReviewView

SubmissionRunProgress.description: Counts from the submitter's own run; values are persisted scheduler states.
SubmissionRunProgress.title: SubmissionRunProgress

TaskSummary.description: Bounded task-list/detail metadata; source payloads are fetched only on request.
TaskSummary.title: TaskSummary

info.description: Published projections and authenticated, review-gated submission requests.
info.title: PolyCodeBench Public API

get.description: Mint a short-lived download URL only for an artifact in a published release.
Serve one bounded, digest-checked object after release and token revalidation.
The frozen methods behind a release, resolved by version as release links expect.

post.description: Create a pending record for the verified principal; never contact or schedule a model.

get.description: Published release identities and disclosed limits; no manifests, no private rows.
Disclosed task versions only; private task identities never appear in a listing.
Fetch bounded, curated task content only after a public task is explicitly opened.
